strings.tierB.home.title: FieldSales: I-software yebatsengisi nekutsengisa ngeveni
strings.tierB.home.description: I-software yebasabalalisi: ema-invoyisi nemarisidi elucingweni lwemtsengisi, sitoko seveni, tinkhokhelo nekuvakasha. Isebenta ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi.
strings.tierB.home.h1: Phatsa batsengisi bakho kusukela ekuvakasheni kwekucala kuze kube senkhokhelweni yekugcina
strings.tierB.home.definition: I-FieldSales yiplatifomu ye-cloud yetinkampani tekusabalalisa naletitsengisa ngebuningi letinebatsengisi labavakashela emakhasimende. Batsengisi bakhipha baphindze baphrinte ema-invoyisi nemarisidi elucingweni lwabo, balandzelela sitoko seveni futsi babhale kuvakasha, ngesikhatsi baphatsi babona kutsengisa, tinkhokhelo leticociwe nemabhalansi emakhasimende ngaso leso sikhatsi.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.title: Ema-invoyisi elucingweni lwemtsengisi
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.line: Umtsengisi ukhipha i-invoyisi emnyango welikhasimende bese ayiphrinta ngephrinta ye-thermal lesebenta nge-Bluetooth ngembi kwekutsi aphume esitolo.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.title: Tinkhokhelo nemabhalansi emakhasimende
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.line: Inkhokhelo ngayinye itfola lirisidi lelinenombolo lelihlanganiswe nema-invoyisi lakhokhelwa ngalo, futsi libhalansi nesitatimende selikhasimende kuvuselelwa ngalokushesha.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.title: Sitoko seveni lesiphetfwe ngumtsengisi
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.line: Sitoko seveni ngayinye silandzelelwa intfo ngentfo: lesilayishiwe, lesitsengisiwe, lesibuyisiwe nalesisele, ngako umehluko uvela ngalo lelo langa.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.title: Tindlela nekuvakasha
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.line: Kuvakasha kubhalwa nendzawo, sikhatsi netitfombe, futsi indlela yemtsengisi ngamunye ikhonjiswa emephini kuze umphatsi ayibone.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.title: Isebenta ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.line: Batsengisi bachubeka batsengisa noma kungekho inethiwekhi. Emadokhumenti alindza elucingweni bese atfunyelwa ngekutentakalela, angaphindzwa, nakubuya kuxhumana.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.title: Ideshibhodi yewebhu yebaphatsi
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.line: Kutsengisa, tinkhokhelo, timphahla letibuyisiwe, sitoko kanye nekusebenta kwebatsengisi endzaweni yinye, kanye netindzima nemalungelo emsebenzisi ngamunye.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.title: Sitjele kutsi utsengisa njani
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.line: Cela ikhotheshini nobe ubhuke umhlangano. Sibuka batsengisi bakho, tindlela, imikhicito netidzingo takho te-invoyisi.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.title: Lungisa inkampani yakho
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.line: Faka imikhicito, tintsengo, emakhasimende nebatsengisi, bese ubeka imali nelizinga lentsela lelive lakho kutilungiselelo.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.title: Tfumela batsengisi etindleleni
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.line: Batsengisi bafaka i-app ku-Android nobe ku-iPhone, balayishe iveni yabo bese bacala kutsengisa, kuphrinta nekucoca tinkhokhelo.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.title: Landzelela lilanga njengoba lenteka
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.line: Ideshibhodi yewebhu ikhombisa kutsengisa, tinkhokhelo, sitoko semaveni nekuvakasha ngesikhatsi batsengisi basesetindleleni.
strings.tierB.home.faq.0.a: I-FieldSales yiplatifomu ye-cloud yekuphatsa batsengisi labavakashela emakhasimende etinkampanini tekusabalalisa naletitsengisa ngebuningi. Ifaka ekhatsi kutsengisa ngeveni (van sales), kutsengisa etindleleni letibekiwe (route sales), kutsatsa ema-oda kusenesikhatsi (pre-sales) nekuletsa timphahla ngco etitolo (DSD). Batsengisi bakhipha ema-invoyisi, baphrinte, bacoce tinkhokhelo futsi babhale kuvakasha elucingweni lwabo, kantsi baphatsi balandzelela kutsengisa, tinkhokhelo, sitoko semaveni nemabhalansi emakhasimende kudeshibhodi yewebhu.
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.a: Yebo. I-app yemtsengisi ichubeka isebenta ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi: batsengisi bakhipha baphindze baphrinte ema-invoyisi nemarisidi, babhale kuvakasha futsi bengete emakhasimende lamasha, futsi konkhe kutfunyelwa ngekutentakalela kungaphindzwa nakubuya kuxhumana. Kukhona umehluko munye eSaudi Arabia: tinkampani letivule kuxhumana kwema-invoyisi e-elekthroniki tidzinga kuxhumana ngesikhatsi kukhishwa i-invoyisi nobe lidokhumenti lekubuyisa timphahla.
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.a: I-FieldSales isebentela tinkampani tekusabalalisa kuwo onkhe emave. Inkampani ngayinye ibeka imali yayo nelizinga lentsela kutilungiselelo tayo, futsi ema-invoyisi, emarisidi nemibiko kuyakusebentisa loko. I-FieldSales isekelwe eRiyadh, eSaudi Arabia, futsi kucala kwentiwa nge-inthanethi ngemihlangano, nge-WhatsApp nangelusito lolwentiwa usekhashane.
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.q: Ingabe i-FieldSales iyahlangana netinhlelo tahulumende tema-invoyisi e-elekthroniki?
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.a: Sisekela kuhlanganiswa kweSigaba Sesibili neplatifomu ye-Fatoora ye-ZATCA. Loku kusebenta etinkampanini taseSaudi Arabia. Kulamanye emave, i-FieldSales ikhipha ema-invoyisi ngemali yakho nangelizinga lakho lentsela, futsi kuhlanganiswa nenhlelo yelive yema-invoyisi e-elekthroniki (e-invoicing) kuyatfolakala nawukucela, ngemuva kwekutsi sihlole tidzingo talelo live nawe. Ngaphandle kweSaudi Arabia asentsi sitsembiso mayelana nemitsetfo yalapho.
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.a: I-app ye-FieldSales itfolakala ngaleti tilwimi kuphela: Arabic, English, French, Turkish and Chinese. Ayitfolakali ngesiSwati. Batsengisi nebaphatsi bangashintja lulwimi lwe-app, futsi ema-invoyisi laphrintiwe angaba nelulwimi lwesibili eceleni kwelulwimi lolukhulu. Emakhasi ewebhusayithi ngaletinye tilwimi, njengalelikhasi lesiSwati, ayinguculo letiniketa lwati ngemkhicito.
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.a: Cela ikhotheshini, bhuka umhlangano nobe usitfumelele umlayeto ku-WhatsApp. Sifundza kutsi batsengisi bakho basebenta njani, bese sikusita kulungisa imikhicito, tintsengo, emakhasimende nebatsengisi. Batsengisi bafaka i-app ku-Android nobe ku-iPhone, futsi baphatsi basebentisa ideshibhodi yewebhu kunoma nguyiphi i-browser. Tisetjentiswa lotidzingako ngema-smartphone kuphela.
strings.tierB.home.uiLanguagesNote: I-app ye-FieldSales itfolakala ngaleti tilwimi: Arabic, English, French, Turkish and Chinese; ayitfolakali ngesiSwati. Emakhasi ngaletinye tilwimi achaza umkhicito kuze utfole lwati kuphela.
strings.tierB.category.title: I-software yekutsengisa ngeveni (van sales) | FieldSales
strings.tierB.category.description: I-software yekutsengisa ngeveni (van sales): ema-invoyisi elucingweni, sitoko seveni, tinkhokhelo nekuvakasha. Isebenta ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi.
strings.tierB.category.h1: I-software yekutsengisa ngeveni yebasabalalisi nebatsengisi ngebuningi
strings.tierB.category.intro: I-FieldSales yi-software yekutsengisa ngeveni yetinkampani letinebatsengisi labatsengisa basuka eveni etindleleni temalanga onkhe. Umtsengisi ulayisha iveni, atsengise esitolo ngasinye, aphrinte i-invoyisi, acoce inkhokhelo bese abhala timphahla letibuyisiwe, konkhe nge-app yinye yelucingo. Umphatsi ubona loko lokulayishiwe, lokutsengisiwe, lokucociwe naloko lokusele eveni ngayinye.
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.title: Yini i-software yekutsengisa ngeveni?
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.body: I-software yekutsengisa ngeveni, lebitwa nangekutsi yi-software ye-route sales, isebentisa indlela yekutsengisa lapho umtsengisi aphatse sitoko emotweni bese atsengisa, aletse timphahla, akhiphe i-invoyisi aphindze acoce inkhokhelo ekuvakasheni kunye. Itsatsa sikhundla setincwadzi tema-invoyisi temaphepha nekushaya ticingo ekupheleni kwelilanga. Ibhala kutsengisa, inkhokhelo netimphahla letibuyisiwe konkhe njengemadokhumenti, ngako sitoko nemali kungacatsaniswa ngalo lelo langa. Kumphatsi, iphendvula imibuto lemitsatfu njalo kusihlwa: umtsengisi ngamunye utsengise ini, ucoce malini, futsi kusele ini eveni ngayinye?
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.title: Lilanga etindleleni
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.body: Lilanga licala ngekulayisha lokubhaliwe kusuka endzaweni yekugcina timphahla kuya eveni. Esitolo ngasinye umtsengisi ukhetsa likhasimende ku-app, engete timphahla ngeluhlu nobe nge-barcode, akhiphe i-invoyisi bese ayiphrinta ngephrinta ye-thermal. Inkhokhelo ibhalwa ngelirisidi, futsi nanobe ngutiphi timphahla letibuyisiwe tibhalwa nesizatfu sato. Ekupheleni kwelilanga, loko lokusele eveni kwehliswa kubuyele endzaweni yekugcina timphahla. Emkhatsini wetinyatselo leti, umphatsi angalandzelela kutsengisa, tinkhokhelo nekuvakasha kwemtsengisi ngamunye kudeshibhodi yewebhu angakashayeli muntfu lucingo.
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.title: Yakhelwe tindzawo letinenethiwekhi lebutsakatsaka
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.body: Tindlela tekusabalalisa tendlula etakhiweni letingaphansi kwemhlaba, etindzaweni temafemu nasemaphandleni lapho inethiwekhi ibutsakatsaka khona. I-app yemtsengisi ye-FieldSales igcina emakhasimende, imikhicito netintsengo elucingweni, ngako umtsengisi angakhipha aphindze aphrinte emadokhumenti ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Lidokhumenti ngalinye linekhiyi lalo lelehlukile, ngako lifika kanye kuphela, noma kutfumela kuphindzwa. Tinkampani taseSaudi Arabia letivule kuxhumana kwema-invoyisi e-elekthroniki tidzinga kuxhumana ngesikhatsi kukhishwa ema-invoyisi nemadokhumenti ekubuyisa timphahla. Emarisidi, kuvakasha nemakhasimende lamasha kusasebenta ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi kuleto tinkampani.
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.title: Tinkhokhelo nesitoko seveni
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.body: Imali lesendleleni idzinga kulawulwa lokufana nekwesitoko. Inkhokhelo ngayinye itfola lirisidi lelinenombolo lelingahlanganiswa nema-invoyisi lakhokhelwa ngalo, futsi libhalansi lelikhasimende livuselelwa ngalokushesha. Sitoko seveni sibalwa intfo ngentfo njengaloko lokulayishiwe kukhishwe lokutsengisiwe, kwengetwe timphahla letibuyisiwe nekulungiswa lokubhaliwe, ngako baphatsi bangasicatsanisa nekubala kwemphela ngembi kwekutsi umtsengisi aye ekhaya. Timphahla letibuyisiwe tingehlukaniswa njengaletijwayelekile, letonakele nobe tekushintjwa, futsi umphatsi uyancuma kutsi tiyabuyela yini esitokweni seveni lesilungele kutsengiswa.
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.title: Ilungele bani?
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.body: I-FieldSales ilungele basabalalisi nebatsengisi ngebuningi betimphahla letitsengiswa ngekushesha (FMCG) njengekudla, tinatfo, tintfo tekuhlanta netekunakekela umtimba, kanye nanobe nguyiphi inkampani lenebatsengisi labavakashela titolo, ema-spaza netitolo letincane etindleleni letibekiwe. Isekela kutsengisa ngeveni, ema-oda ekusenesikhatsi (pre-sales) nekuletsa timphahla ngco etitolo (DSD). Ayisiyo i-ERP lephelele: iyahlangana nenhlelo yakho ye-accounting nobe ye-ERP nge-API. Baphatsi balawula loko umtsengisi ngamunye langakwenta, njengekuniketa sephulelo, kutsengisa ngaphansi kwentsengo yeluhlu nobe kwengeta emakhasimende lamasha.
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.q: Yini umehluko emkhatsini wekutsengisa ngeveni ne-pre-sales?
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.a: Ekutsengiseni ngeveni umtsengisi uphatsa sitoko bese aletsa timphahla, akhiphe i-invoyisi aphindze acoce inkhokhelo ekuvakasheni kunye. Ku-pre-sales umtsengisi utsatsa i-oda letfunyelwa yindzawo yekugcina timphahla ngemuva kwaloko. I-FieldSales isekela kokubili, ngako inkampani ingasebentisa emaveni kuletinye tindlela futsi itsatse ema-oda kuletinye. Kuko kokubili, ema-invoyisi, tinkhokhelo nemabhalansi emakhasimende kusenhlelweni yinye, futsi baphatsi bakubona emibikweni lefanako.
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.q: Ngisilinganisa njani sitoko seveni ekupheleni kwelilanga?
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.a: I-FieldSales ikhombisa, entfweni ngayinye eveni ngayinye, sibalo lesilayishiwe, lesitsengisiwe, lesibuyisiwe nalesisele. Catsanisa lesisele nekubala kwemphela, ubhale nanobe ngumuphi umehluko njengekulungiswa lokubhaliwe, bese wehlisela lokusele endzaweni yekugcina timphahla ngekunyakata kunye. Iveni icala lilanga lelilandzelako nelibhalansi lelihlantekile leliyatiwako.
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.q: Umtsengisi lotsengisa ngeveni udzinga tiphi tisetjentiswa?
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.a: I-smartphone, i-Android nobe i-iPhone. Iphrinta ye-thermal lesebenta nge-Bluetooth ayiphoceleleki, futsi isita umtsengisi kuniketa likhasimende i-invoyisi nobe lirisidi leliphrintiwe. I-FieldSales ayitsengisi tisetjentiswa futsi ayidzingi luhlobo lolutsite lwephrinta. Baphatsi basebentisa ideshibhodi yewebhu ku-browser yanoma nguyiphi ikhompyutha nobe lucingo.
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.q: Ingabe i-FieldSales ingahlangana nenhlelo yetfu ye-accounting?
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.a: Yebo. I-FieldSales iniketa i-API lesita inhlelo yakho ye-accounting nobe ye-ERP kutsi ishintjisane neplatifomu ngemakhasimende, imikhicito, ema-invoyisi, emarisidi nekunyakata kwesitoko. Lithimba lakho nobe inkampani yakho ye-IT yakha loku kuhlangana isebentisa emadokhumenti e-API.
strings.tierB.countries.title: I-FieldSales ngelive: imali, intsela ne-e-invoicing
strings.tierB.countries.description: I-FieldSales isebentela basabalalisi kuwo onkhe emave. Bona imali, intsela yekutsengisa nesimo se-e-invoicing selive ngalinye ethebulini linye.
strings.tierB.countries.intro: I-FieldSales isebentela tinkampani tekusabalalisa kuwo onkhe emave. Inkampani ngayinye ikhetsa live layo, imali nelizinga lentsela kutilungiselelo tayo, futsi ema-invoyisi, emarisidi nemibiko kuyakulandzela loko. Kuhlanganiswa nahulumende kwema-invoyisi e-elekthroniki kusebenta eSaudi Arabia kuphela. Kuwo onkhe lamanye emave kuyatfolakala nawukucela. Lithebula lelingentasi likhombisa, kulive ngalinye, imali yalapho, lizinga lelijwayelekile lentsela yekutsengisa nobe i-VAT, nekutsi kuhlanganiswa nahulumende kwema-invoyisi e-elekthroniki kuyasebenta yini nobe kuyatfolakala nawukucela.
strings.tierB.countries.einvoicingLive: Sisekela kuhlanganiswa kweSigaba Sesibili neplatifomu ye-Fatoora ye-ZATCA
strings.tierB.countries.taxNote: Imali nelizinga lentsela kubekwa yinkampani ngayinye kutilungiselelo tayo. Emazinga lakulelithebula ayindlela yekukhombisa nje futsi angashintja; buta umeluleki wakho wentsela ngemitsetfo yanyalo. Umugca (—) usho kutsi akukho lizinga lelijwayelekile lelibhaliwe kulelo live.
strings.tierB.about.title: Mayelana ne-FieldSales
strings.tierB.about.description: I-FieldSales yakha i-software ye-cloud yetinkampani tekusabalalisa letinebatsengisi. Yasungulwa nga-2026 eRiyadh, eSaudi Arabia.
strings.tierB.about.body.0: I-FieldSales (libito ngesi-Arabhu: فيلد سيلز) yiplatifomu ye-cloud yetinkampani tekusabalalisa naletitsengisa ngebuningi letinebatsengisi labavakashela emakhasimende. Inkampani yasungulwa nga-2026 futsi isekelwe eRiyadh, eSaudi Arabia. Isebentela tinkampani kuwo onkhe emave, futsi imali nelizinga lentsela lelive ngalinye kubekwa kutilungiselelo tenkampani ngekwayo. Emakhasimende etfu tinkampani letitsengisa futsi tiletse timphahla ngebatsengisi labasetindleleni: basabalalisi, batsengisi ngebuningi nebakhiciti labanemaveni abo labatsengisa ngawo.
strings.tierB.about.body.1: Sakha inhlelo yinye lehlanganisiwe yemjikelezo wonkhe wasetindleleni: ema-invoyisi laphrintwa ngelucingo lwemtsengisi, emarisidi nemabhalansi emakhasimende, sitoko seveni lesiphetfwe ngumtsengisi, tindlela nekuvakasha nendzawo netitfombe, kanye nedeshibhodi yewebhu yebaphatsi. I-app yemtsengisi isebenta ku-Android naku-iPhone futsi ichubeka isebenta ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi, bese ivuselela nakubuya kuxhumana. Tinkampani tingahlanganisa i-FieldSales nenhlelo yato ye-accounting nobe ye-ERP nge-API, kuze idatha yasetindleleni ingadzingi kubhalwa kabili.
strings.tierB.about.body.2: Sichaza umkhicito njengoba unjalo. Sisekela kuhlanganiswa kweSigaba Sesibili neplatifomu ye-Fatoora ye-ZATCA. Kuhlanganiswa netinhlelo tahulumende kulamanye emave kuyatfolakala nawukucela. I-app itfolakala ngaleti tilwimi: Arabic, English, French, Turkish and Chinese; ayitfolakali ngesiSwati. Kute ukhulume natsi, cela ikhotheshini, bhuka umhlangano nobe usitfumelele umlayeto ku-WhatsApp.
strings.tierB.contact.title: Xhumana ne-FieldSales
strings.tierB.contact.description: Khuluma nelithimba le-FieldSales: cela ikhotheshini, bhuka umhlangano nobe ukhulume natsi ku-WhatsApp mayelana ne-software yekutsengisa ngeveni.
strings.tierB.contact.intro: Sitjele kutsi batsengisi bakho batsengisa njani lamuhla naloko lofuna kukushintja. Cela ikhotheshini, bhuka umhlangano nobe usitfumelele umlayeto ku-WhatsApp, futsi lilunga lelithimba letfu litakuphendvula. Tinkampani lesetivele tisebentisa i-FieldSales tingasebentisa tindlela letifanako kutfola lusito. Kuyasita kusho live lakho, linani lebatsengisi nekutsi batsengisa basuka emaveni, batsatsa ema-oda nobe kokubili.
strings.tierB.contact.meetingIntro: Bhuka umhlangano we-inthanethi nelithimba letfu. Sitakukhombisa lilanga lemtsengisi ku-app nakudeshibhodi yemphatsi, sisebentisa tibonelo letisedvute nemikhicito netindlela takho, siphindze siphendvule imibuto yakho mayelana nekulungisa.
